81199000/OneDuo.description: One-click signing: free signing with your own Apple ID to install apps on iPhone / iPad, with automatic Wi‑Fi renewal (based on Impactor, MIT)
81199000/OneDuo.body:
> ⭐ **Give it a Star, and follow [@81199000](https://github.com/81199000) so you don't get lost.** The official site **[oneduo.app](https://oneduo.app)** is the long-term fixed entry point; even if the repository moves later, you can still find it from the official site.

## Related Projects

- **[DouDuo](https://github.com/81199000/DouDuo)**: Third-party Douyin client, native SwiftUI, adapted for foldable inner screens / iPad; recommendations, comments, direct messages, and livestreams all work.
- **[GuoDuo](https://github.com/81199000/GuoDuo)**: Third-party client for Hongguo short dramas, native playback, adapted for foldables / iPad, works together with GuoDuo TV.
- **[GuoDuo TV](https://github.com/81199000/GuoDuo-TV)**: Android TV / projector version of GuoDuo: binge-watch with a remote control, scan with your phone to use it as a remote, and continue watching across phone and TV.
- **[一键签 OneDuo](https://github.com/81199000/OneDuo)** (this project): Windows / Mac installation tool that uses your own Apple ID to sign the apps above for free and install them on your phone, with automatic renewal when they expire and automatic updates when new versions are released.
- Official site **[oneduo.app](https://oneduo.app)**: the unified download entry point for all projects.

---

## Tutorial

### 1. Download and Install

Go to the official site **[oneduo.app](https://oneduo.app/#download)** to download the installer for your system (if the download is slow, you can use the [Gitee backup download](https://gitee.com/remon8/oneduo/releases)).

**Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)**:

1. Download `OneDuo-x.y.z-windows-x64-setup.exe` and double-click to run it.
2. A blue "**Windows protected your PC**" prompt will appear: click **More info** on the left, then click **Run anyway**.
   > OneDuo does not have a Microsoft code-signing certificate, so Windows shows this prompt once. It is not a virus. It only appears during the first installation.
3. When asked "Do you want to allow this app to make changes to your device?", click **Yes**.
4. Click **Next** through the installation wizard until it finishes. It is recommended to keep "start automatically when the computer boots" enabled, since automatic renewal depends on it.

The installer automatically installs the Apple iPhone driver and Bonjour (used to find the phone over Wi‑Fi), so you do not need to install iTunes separately.

AmbaRu/rizpaq.description: ZPAQ power without the console. Desktop archiver for Windows: versioned ZPAQ backups, PAR2 protection, ZIP/7z/RAR support. GUI for zpaqfranz.
AmbaRu/rizpaq.body:
# Rizpaq

**ZPAQ power without the console. One app for every archive you own.**

Rizpaq is a desktop archiver for Windows. It puts the full strength of
[zpaqfranz](https://github.com/fcorbelli/zpaqfranz) — file versions, global
deduplication, one of the best compression ratios available — behind a clean,
familiar interface. Alongside it, Rizpaq opens, extracts, and *converts*
ZIP, 7z, and RAR archives, so a single tool covers what used to need three.

Every archive can also be wrapped into a **PAR2 recovery set** kept
right next to it: background bit-rot becomes a detectable, repairable
problem instead of a silent loss.

No install. No console. No scripting. Three engines are built in.

---

## What problem does it solve

### "I want my files to have a history, not just a copy"

An ordinary archive is a snapshot: one moment, frozen. Restore it next year
and you get *that* moment back — every file, all of it, or nothing.

HuoXiaolin/BigFishDockpro.body:
# 大肥鱼Dock · BigFishDockpro

A desktop organization and beautification tool for **Windows 10 / 11 x64**. Launch apps with the Dock, organize files with cards, and check your computer's status, AI usage, and schedule with the dynamic capsules. The Windows 11 Start menu, search, and notifications can also use the same glass look.

[Download releases](https://github.com/HuoXiaolin/BigFishDockpro/releases) · [User guide](https://github.com/HuoXiaolin/BigFishDockpro/blob/HEAD/使用说明.md) · [Changelog](https://github.com/HuoXiaolin/BigFishDockpro/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md) · [Issues](https://github.com/HuoXiaolin/BigFishDockpro/issues)

*Interface demos use original backgrounds and sample data; glass panels use 90% opacity.*

## Download and Getting Started

| Version | How to use |
| --- | --- |
| Installer | Run `BigFishDockpro-Setup-x64.exe` and follow the setup wizard. |
| Portable single-file version | Place `BigFishDockpro.exe` in a fixed location and run it; no Python installation required. |

1. Click the “＋” on the Dock to pin apps, files, or folders, or drag them in directly. Files and folders can also be dragged into desktop storage cards.
2. Right-click the Dock to open settings, adjust the material, position, and icons, and enable desktop widgets as needed.
3. When changing computers, export your configuration from “Data & Backup”. Both versions share the configuration stored in `%APPDATA%\BigFishDock`.

## Dock and Desktop Organization

With mouse passthrough enabled, hold the left Alt or right Alt key to temporarily click or drag the Dock, capsules, and desktop cards. Release the key to restore the original passthrough rules. “Temporarily disable mouse passthrough while holding Alt” is on by default and can be toggled in the tray right-click menu under “System appearance → Mouse passthrough” or in “Settings → Dock appearance → Docking and interaction”.

The Dock supports grouping, icon reflections, circular icons, auto-hide, window switching, and unified search, and you can save multiple layouts. Right-click “Batch app management” to add or remove shortcut entries in bulk. Files and folders use the system icons from desktop cards, and images show proportionally scaled thumbnails. The Dock only stores shortcut mappings; removing an entry leaves the original files and folders where they are.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

MasaoC/GPS-TFT-Map_PONS.body:
# PONS — GPS/GNSS navigation device for human-powered aircraft for the Japan International Birdman Rally v7.1

**PONS (Pilot Oriented Navigation System)** is a navigation device designed to be easy for human-powered aircraft pilots to use. It is specialized for the Birdman Rally on Lake Biwa.  
As the electronics of a Birdman team (pilot instruments and GPS navigation), it conveys the map, ground speed, heading, attitude, variometer (vertical speed indicator), and wind direction and speed through a single screen and voice.
The PCB (KiCad), firmware (Arduino), and 3D-printed case data are published as open source.  
GPS/GNSS navigation for human-powered aircraft, specialized for the Japan International Birdman Rally at Lake Biwa, Japan. → [English summary](#english-summary)

* **Track record**: Osaka University albatross (2024 chase boat: v3 / 2025 chase boat: v4 / 2025 aircraft-mounted "Byakuya": v5 /
  2026 chase boat: v6 / 2026 aircraft-mounted "Yokan": v6β). **Winner of the 2025 rally.**
* **This branch (`PONSv7.1`) is for the v7.1 PCB only, targeting the 2027 and 2028 rallies.**  
  It uses the Murata SCH16T-K01 for attitude sensing (external FPC) and includes power-circuit safety measures (Q3/Q4/F1/U10), making it the latest design.  
  The original v7 PCB with the BNO085 was discontinued (2026-11-22).
* **The v3–v6 branches are stable versions that have actually been used in flight.** v7.1 has not yet been used in a rally.

---

## Benefits of PONS

**It is both a "tool" used while flying and a "measuring instrument" after flying.** It can be used both for guidance on the day and for designing the next aircraft.

XhyEax/SoftApHelper.body:
# SoftApHelper (Xposed)

An Xposed module for configuring Android hotspots.

## Features

1. Customize the Wi-Fi hotspot IPv4 address (Android 9+) and the Ethernet tethering IPv4 address (Android 11+).
2. Hide the metered network flag of the hotspot (Android 10+).
3. Customize or randomly generate the hotspot BSSID, with an option to re-randomize it every time the hotspot is turned on (Android 13+).
4. Configure optional channels and maximum bandwidth for the 5 GHz hotspot (Android 13+).
5. Stop the Wi-Fi hotspot from advertising IPv6 to clients (Android 11+, experimental, disabled by default).

## Usage

1. Install the module, enable it in LSPosed and set the [scope](#作用域) below, then restart the phone.
2. Open SoftApHelper, set the hotspot IP, BSSID, 5 GHz channel/bandwidth, or IPv6 options, then tap "Save".
3. Turn the hotspot off and back on for the new configuration to take effect. The "Hotspot IP (actual IP)" shown on the page displays the Wi-Fi hotspot address most recently reported by the module.

The Wi-Fi hotspot IP defaults to `192.168.1.1`. You can choose `192.168.43.1`, `172.20.10.1`, or `172.31.10.1`, or enter an address manually. The Ethernet tethering IP defaults to `192.168.45.1` and must be saved separately after switching to "Ethernet hotspot". Only private IPv4 addresses in the `10.x.x.x`, `172.16-31.x.x`, or `192.168.x.x` ranges are accepted, and the last octet cannot be `0` or `255`.

The BSSID defaults to `aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff`. When "Replace hotspot MAC address" is turned off, the hotspot uses the system-generated BSSID. The "Random" button generates a new address. "Randomize MAC address on each hotspot start" generates a new address every time the hotspot is turned on.

The 5 GHz channel field accepts a comma-separated list, and the page offers two quick-fill presets: `36,40,44` and `149,153,157,161,165`. The maximum bandwidth can be `20`, `40`, `80`, `160`, or `320 MHz`. The module applies these settings only when the system sets the hotspot to 5 GHz and neither a single channel nor ACS optional channels are specified. Actual channels and bandwidth are still limited by the device, region, and system.

## Known issue on Android 14
On some Android 14 systems, caching prevents the module from taking effect until you manually **re-optimize Tethering**:

LSPosed - Module - SoftApHelper - long-press Tethering - Re-optimize - Restart phone

[Image example](https://xhy-1252675344.cos.ap-beijing.myqcloud.com/imgs/softap-redex.jpg)

codertj93/JetChat.body:
# JetChat

JetChat is an instant messaging sample project built with Swift 5. It includes one-on-one chat, group chat, an emoji keyboard, image and video messages, local message caching, Moments, theme switching, and a Widget.

## Features

- One-on-one chat, group chat, conversation list, and unread badges
- Text, emoji, image, and video messages
- `ZLPhotoBrowser` album selection, with image caching, video export, and cover generation
- `JXPhotoBrowser` image preview and system video playback
- Moments, likes, comments, and nine-grid images
- SQLite/WCDB local message and conversation caching
- Light, dark, and follow-system themes
- Chinese/English language switching
- Widget showing recent chats
- Adaptive collapsed, half-expanded, and expanded states on iPhone and iPhone Duo

## Tech Stack

| Module | Technology |
| --- | --- |
| UI | UIKit, MVVM, SnapKit |
| Reactive state | RxSwift, RxCocoa |
| Networking | Moya, Alamofire |
| Local storage | WCDB.swift |
| List layout | IGListKit |
| Image loading | Kingfisher |
| Image browsing | JXPhotoBrowser |
| Album selection | ZLPhotoBrowser |
| Theming | SwiftTheme |
| Dependency management | CocoaPods |

## Runtime Requirements

- iOS 17.6+
- Xcode 27
- Swift 5
- CocoaPods

## Installation and Running

```bash
cd JetChat
pod install
open FY-IMChat.xcworkspace
```

Always open `.xcworkspace`, not `.xcodeproj`.

`Pods/` is not under version control. After pulling the code, run `pod install` to restore dependencies. `Podfile.lock` is committed to lock dependency versions.

ewigl/hifini-auto-checkin.body:
## HIFINI Music Magnetic Field Scheduled Automatic Check-in

Supports simultaneous check-in for multiple accounts. Supports Telegram notifications. Only supports `hifiti.com`.

### Usage

1. Fork this repository.
2. Enable Actions in the forked repository.
3. Configure repository variables.

Detailed documentation: https://ewigl.github.io/projects/github-actions-tasks/

### Repository Variables

- **ACCOUNTS**: Account information. It is recommended to use a JSON editing tool to avoid formatting errors.

  Configuration example:

  ```json
  [
    {
      "name": "Enter account note here",
      "cookie": "Enter Cookie here"
    },
    {
      "name": "Enter account note here. If there is only one account, you can delete this {} record",
      "cookie": "Enter Cookie here. If you have two or more accounts, add new {} records below."
    }
  ]
  ```

  Getting the Cookie:

  After logging in to hifiti.com, open the browser console and get the Cookie from the network monitoring interface. Make sure the Cookie contains both the bbs_token and bbs_sid fields. Clicking the "Logout" button in the upper right corner of the website will invalidate the Cookie.


- **TELEGRAM_TOKEN**: (Optional) Bot Token for Telegram notifications.
- **TELEGRAM_TO**: (Optional) Chat ID for Telegram notifications.

### Notes

According to [GitHub's policy](https://docs.github.com/zh/actions/managing-workflow-runs-and-deployments/managing-workflow-runs/disabling-and-enabling-a-workflow?tool=webui), GitHub automatically disables scheduled Actions workflows when there has been no repository activity for 60 days. They need to be manually re-enabled.

genellect/cytellect.body:
# Cytellect

**Get your microscopy publication-ready.**

🏆 Winner, Tokyo AI Hackathon 2026

[Product LP](https://cytellect.app/) · [Public demo](https://cytellect.app/demo) · [Windows](https://github.com/genellect/cytellect/releases/tag/v0.1.0-local.24) · [Docker](https://github.com/genellect/cytellect/blob/HEAD/docs/docker-desktop.md) · [Statistical analysis methods](https://github.com/genellect/cytellect/blob/HEAD/docs/implementation-overview.ja.md#統計解析) · [Documentation](https://github.com/genellect/cytellect/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md)

Cytellect is an analysis platform for life science researchers that handles everything from microscopy image analysis through statistical processing to graph output. For instance segmentation it uses the deep learning models StarDist and Cellpose-SAM (SAM ViT-L), and for quantification and statistical inference it uses shared implementations built on NumPy, SciPy, and statsmodels.

## For those who want to contribute to development

If you take part in development, read the following three documents in order, and check the relevant sections each time you work. AI agents follow the same documents.

1. [Team development rules](https://github.com/genellect/cytellect/blob/HEAD/docs/team-development.md): development workflow, Git and review, and handling of research data
2. [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/genellect/cytellect/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md): building and starting the development environment, and checks to run before opening a PR
3. [Development principles](https://github.com/genellect/cytellect/blob/HEAD/docs/development-principles.md): principles to follow for computation, statistics, data, UI, and releases

Other documents are collected in [Documentation](https://github.com/genellect/cytellect/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md).

# jav-trans

**One-click generation of Japanese, Chinese, or bilingual SRT subtitles for Japanese-language videos.** Select a video in the local desktop window, and it automatically completes Japanese speech recognition, timeline alignment, translation (local or API), and subtitle formatting and export.

[**⬇ Download Windows release package**](https://github.com/jaykwok/jav-trans/releases/latest/download/jav-trans-windows-x64.zip) · [Release notes](https://github.com/jaykwok/jav-trans/releases/latest) · [Quick start](#快速开始) · [Translation modes](#选择翻译模式) · [Upgrading](#升级到新版本) · [FAQ](#常见问题)

> **Requirements**: Windows 10/11 + NVIDIA GPU (≥ 8 GB VRAM).
>
> **Privacy note**: Videos and audio are always processed only on your machine. When you choose "Local translation" or "Japanese only," subtitle text also never leaves your machine. Subtitles are saved by default to the folder containing the video.

*Standard mode operation illustration (①–④ are step annotations; the tasks and progress shown in the interface are demo data; click to view the full-size image).*

---

## Runtime requirements

| Item | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| **System** | Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit) |
| **GPU** | NVIDIA discrete GPU with at least **8 GB physical VRAM** (must support CUDA; no CPU fallback) |

oimasterkafuu/Roka.body:
# Roka

Roka is a real-time grid-based territory war game, similar in gameplay to generals.io. Players expand territory, build capitals and command posts, and in FFA or team matches, capture the enemy capital and survive to the end.

The server is built with TypeScript, Fastify, and Socket.IO, and the frontend is mainly vanilla JavaScript. Matches are settled by the server per Tick, with support for reconnection after disconnects, spectating, and full replays.

## Key Features

- Real-time FFA and team matches, with multiple maps, map sizes, random seeds, and three fog modes (default: normal).
- In real-time matches, move the cursor with the arrow keys and push troops with WASD. Numeric squads 0–19 are only valid within the current match. Multi-line battles support multi-select and synchronized troop pushing. For shortcuts, see `/tutorial`.
- In real-time matches, the red frame for the burst period at Ticks 26–50 is shown only in single-line play. Multi-line battles have no burst period and show no red frame.
- When an isolated cell reconnects to the network, only cells whose current troop count is greater than 1 and that received no reinforcements during the isolated period are doubled. A cell with 1 troop stays at 1, and cells that received reinforcements keep their current troop count.
- User registration and login, Rating, points, personal profiles, feeds, comments, and promotion ambassadors.
- Room chat, real-time online status, browser notifications, and an admin dashboard.
- Replay viewing, downloading, local upload, and querying historical replays by user and date.
- GitHub account binding and gold Star display for the top half of the ranking. The About page publicly showcases contributors and all Star supporters.
- Strategy bots that can run standalone or be hosted by the server. Protocol documentation is at `/develop/bot`.
- A first-visit intro video, static asset CDN, and origin fallback on failure.

## Canyon Corridor

Maze mode generates corridors, capitals, and swamps based on the actual number of participants. It selects locations within several connected mazes with loops, avoids dead ends where possible, and, while preserving spacing between combatants, prioritizes improving flat cells that produce troops within 6 and 10 steps of the weakest player's position. Territory is divided by shortest path distance to the capital, with tied cells split evenly. Swamps are preferentially placed in areas far from the initial expansion range that have a larger share of flat cells. The final capital positions are assigned to seats only after an independent seeded shuffle.

The maze keeps only the current generation and initialization path. It does not keep compatibility copies, version markers, or dual paths for old algorithms or old replays. Live matches and operation replays use the same map generation and seat assignment rules, and operation replays are rebuilt directly under the current rules. Already-encoded spectator frames, other maps, and room settings are unchanged.

`pnpm run test:maze-fairness` runs the dedicated regression test (also included in `pnpm run test:map-generation` and `pnpm test`). To compare against a baseline, use `pnpm exec tsx scripts/evaluate-maze-fairness.mjs /tmp/maze-final.json /tmp/maze-baseline.json`. If no baseline is passed, the command generates the baseline JSON. Both runs measure, through the engine and room size rules, 2–16 players in standard and large rooms, with 24 fixed seeds per tier.

## Local Development

Requires Node.js, and uses the pnpm version declared by the repository. First run:

git clone https://github.com/renjiegod/dsh-godbot.git
cd dsh-godbot

Open the web page through the login entry provided by DSH, then click **Godbot** (`/#/godbot`) in the sidebar. Select a model for GodBot, then create new team members. Native DSH members require a usable model configured in that profile.

On Linux hosts without a desktop, start with `dsh web --no-open`.

If you see `This DSH profile uses a separate copy` after installation, follow the steps to fix the dependency links of the original profile. [Installation troubleshooting](https://github.com/renjiegod/dsh-godbot/blob/HEAD/docs/user-guide.zh-CN.md#安装后提示-dsh-依赖有两份)

tyxiumud/gvim_for_verilog.body:
# GVim for Verilog

A set of Vim/GVim configurations for daily Verilog development. The project places common configurations and plugins directly in the repository. After installation, you get features such as a file tree, status bar, bracket auto-completion, port generation, module instantiation, and `xvlog` syntax checking.

This project prioritizes simplicity, offline availability, and ease of modification. You can use the full configuration directly, or pick only the mappings, functions, or plugins you need.

## Main Features

- Verilog syntax highlighting and common editing options
- NERDTree file tree and Airline status bar
- Automatic bracket completion and rainbow brackets
- Quick generation of `input` and `output` port declarations
- Add or update file headers, module names, and modification times
- Generate module instantiation templates and testbench skeletons
- Use ALE to call Vivado `xvlog` for syntax checking
- Quick buffer switching, closing, and cross-file search
- Optional Chinese Vim help documentation

## Before You Begin

Vim/GVim 8.2 or later is recommended. Before starting installation, please note the following dependencies and configuration behaviors:

- Syntax checking depends on an external Verilog tool. The repository example uses Vivado `xvlog`, and you can choose a different one on your machine. See [ALE usage guide](https://github.com/tyxiumud/gvim_for_verilog/blob/HEAD/docs/ale.md).
- `,ig` uses the repository's bundled Vimscript instantiation plugin, while `,tb` still uses Vim's legacy `:python` interface. For requirements, usage, and limitations, see [generator script notes](https://github.com/tyxiumud/gvim_for_verilog/blob/HEAD/docs/custom-generators.md).
- The current `.vimrc` disables swap, backup, and persistent undo files. Save or back up your original configuration first, then decide whether to keep these options.
- Window size and font use preset values. If they don't suit your screen, modify `lines`, `columns`, and `guifont` in `.vimrc`.
- This repository includes plugins, so no separate plugin manager is needed.

## Quick Installation

The core of installation has only two parts: merge `.vimrc`, then place the `pack` directory from the repository into Vim's package path.

### Linux

1. Back up your existing `~/.vimrc`.
2. Merge the contents of the repository's `.vimrc` into `~/.vimrc`. If you have no personal configuration, you can also copy it directly.
3. Copy the entire `pack` directory from the repository to `~/.vim/`.

The ALE entry point after installation should be located at:

```text
~/.vim/pack/ale/start/ale/plugin/ale.vim
```

# comic-dl

[English](https://github.com/yinyanfr/comic-dl/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · [更新日志（英文）](https://github.com/yinyanfr/comic-dl/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md)

comic-dl is a command-line tool and TypeScript library that adds comic sources through extensions, saving each chapter as a CBZ.

```sh
comic-dl d "https://www.copy20.com/comic/xiangkanbaitiantongxuederuanruobiaoqing"
```

After installing the CopyManga extension described below, paste a series link and it will automatically select a source and download the entire comic to the current directory. `d` is shorthand for `download`.

```sh
comic-dl d xiangkanbaitiantongxuederuanruobiaoqing --source copymanga -o ~/manga -c 2-4
```

You can also use the series' short ID directly. `-o` specifies the download directory, and `-c 2-4` downloads chapters 2 through 4 in reading order (inclusive). If the range exceeds the chapter list, the command reports an error and does not start downloading.

CBZ files are written directly to the output directory. When downloading multiple series for a reader, specify a separate directory for each series, for example `-o ~/manga/作品名`.

## Installation

Use Node.js 24. The core does not include online comic sources; the CLI installs extensions with `add`:

```sh
npm install -g comic-dl
comic-dl add @comic-dl/copymanga
comic-dl sources
```

`comic-dl update @comic-dl/copymanga` updates a single extension, `comic-dl update` updates all of them, and `comic-dl remove @comic-dl/copymanga` uninstalls. The extensions we maintain are located at [comic-dl-extensions](https://github.com/yinyanfr/comic-dl-extensions); third parties may also publish npm packages independently.

## Usage in a Project

```sh
npm install comic-dl @comic-dl/zerobyw
```

yuchen0x1/HongGuo-PC.description: Windows desktop client for Hongguo short dramas, supporting search, playback, series tracking, download management, resume-from-breakpoint viewing, and a local drama library.
yuchen0x1/HongGuo-PC.body:
# Hongguo Short Drama · Desktop Edition

**Pick a favorite and let the story go on.**

Search for dramas, play, download, follow updates, and merge and export them, all in one window.

[Download](#-下载) · [Screenshots](#-界面) · [Features](#-功能) · [FAQ](#-常见问题) · [Development](#-开发) · [Disclaimer](#-声明)

---

## 📦 Download

Download the Windows x64 installer from the [latest stable release](https://github.com/yuchen0x1/HongGuo-PC/releases/latest).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Download link** | [GitHub Releases latest](https://github.com/yuchen0x1/HongGuo-PC/releases/latest) |
| **File** | `hongguo-downloader-<版本>-win-x64-setup.exe` |
| **Install** | Double-click to run. Guided setup, with a choice of install directory |

The installer is **not code-signed**. If a SmartScreen prompt appears on first run, click More info → Run anyway.

Installers for previous versions are kept on the [releases page](https://github.com/yuchen0x1/HongGuo-PC/releases).

> The release page also has a `latest.yml`. It is the metadata that automatic updates need for older and later installed versions. It is not an installer, so do not run it on its own.

### In-app updates

The Windows x64 NSIS installed version checks GitHub stable releases. Since 6.32, after the download completes and the official file size, SHA-256, and SHA-512 are verified, you choose when to restart and install. Older clients continue to use their original update flows. Development, preview, and portable builds can be downloaded and installed manually from the GitHub releases page. For details, see the [in-app update guide](https://github.com/yuchen0x1/HongGuo-PC/blob/HEAD/docs/AUTO_UPDATE.md).

6.37 has been officially released. Real v6.35 → v6.37 update reminders, downloads, verification, restart-and-install, and isolated data retention acceptance tests passed. GitHub official priority, GH-Proxy fallback downloads, and integrity verification remain in place. The two GH-Proxy domains belong to the same service. For the scope of network verification, see the [6.32 release notes](https://github.com/yuchen0x1/HongGuo-PC/blob/HEAD/docs/release-6.32.md).

ziyuanhuishequ/release-downloader.description: Batch-download GitHub Release files and automatically archive them by system: a no-install single-file exe plus browser extensions (Chrome/Edge/Firefox), with multi-threaded chunked downloads, resumable downloads, and a dynamic acceleration route pool.
ziyuanhuishequ/release-downloader.body:
# GitHub 下载整理工具

批量下载多个仓库的 GitHub Release 文件，并按系统与架构自动归档到不同文件夹。免安装单文件 exe，像素风界面，Windows 平台。

## 下载

| 用途 | 文件 |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 桌面版（推荐，免安装） | [`GitHub-Release-Downloader-Desktop-v1.6.5.exe`](https://github.com/ziyuanhuishequ/release-downloader/releases/latest/download/GitHub-Release-Downloader-Desktop-v1.6.5.exe) |
| Chrome / Edge / Brave / 360 / QQ | [`GitHub-Release-Downloader-Ext-v1.2.1-chrome.zip`](https://github.com/ziyuanhuishequ/release-downloader/releases/latest/download/GitHub-Release-Downloader-Ext-v1.2.1-chrome.zip) |
| Firefox | [`GitHub-Release-Downloader-Ext-v1.2.1-firefox.zip`](https://github.com/ziyuanhuishequ/release-downloader/releases/latest/download/GitHub-Release-Downloader-Ext-v1.2.1-firefox.zip) |

上面四个文件都在 [**最新 Release**](https://github.com/ziyuanhuishequ/release-downloader/releases/latest) 的 Assets 里，
点文件名即可直接下载。扩展的每个历史版本另有单独 Release（如
[ext-v1.2.1](https://github.com/ziyuanhuishequ/release-downloader/releases/tag/ext-v1.2.1)）。

**装扩展**：解压到固定目录（别放临时目录，删了扩展就失效）→ `chrome://extensions`
（Edge 是 `edge://extensions`）→ 右上角开启「开发者模式」→「加载已解压的扩展程序」→ 选解压出来的文件夹。
扩展是「加载已解压」安装，**不会自动更新**：换新版后覆盖解压，再到扩展页点「重新加载」。
